name: Perspective consistency

detection.task: Is one constraint inconsistent with the others (as an object pasted in under another light or perspective)?
detection.positives: 120 sets of 3, 5 or 8 constraints per angle, one turned by the stated angle
detection.negatives: 120 consistent sets with simulated click error (sigma 1 and 2 px)

known_failure_modes: Lens distortion bends straight lines and can create false conflicts; use lens-corrected images.
Lines that are only nearly parallel in the scene, or that belong to different directions, produce false conflicts.
